teach.narration_en: The mushaf carries a couple of small marks worth knowing. A tiny alif floating above a letter adds a hidden long 'aa' you'd otherwise miss — هَٰذَا (haadha, 'this') is haa-dhaa, not ha-dha. You'll see the same mark again very soon in الرَّحْمَٰن. Small marks like this are notes on how to say what's already there — read the big letters, not the small ones.
teach.focus_en: A small floating alif marks a hidden long vowel — don't skip it.
